name: example-html-ppt-dir-key-nav-minimal
title: Html Ppt Dir Key Nav Minimal
description: 8-slide minimal arrow-key keynote — each slide gets its own monochrome background (indigo / cream / crimson / emerald / gray / purple / white / charcoal), 160px display heading + 4px short accent bar divider, mono-spaced bullet list with arrow → prefix, ←/→ kbd hints in the bottom-left and a page number in the bottom-right, and generous breathing room. Built for "have something to say but nothing to look at" keynotes, launches, and public talks.

query.en: Use the html-ppt-dir-key-nav-minimal template to create an 8-page minimal keynote. Each page should use a single-color background, one 160px headline, and a few arrow-list bullets. First ask me for the talk topic, then turn the 8 core points into 8 slides with one idea per page.
